mechanisms.review: The 360 professional points are allocated only among the eight named skills. The text says Anthropology must have at least 75% overall but does not say this must be achieved during the professional phase; enforce the final minimum only after the separate 180 personal-interest allocation, which may overlap professional skills. Credit Rating is not in the eight-skill list and is printed as 64. English Own Language is in the named list and starts at the printed 90; an allocation UI must preserve the printed starting score and normal 99 cap, not treat 90 as a fixed final score. The male/female Nadelmann presentations are alternate character sheets, not separate rulesets.

source.text: Getting Started / physical or mental trauma

mechanisms.review: PDF p.7 (printed p.66) says a major wound with unconsciousness redirects to 191; PDF p.8 (printed p.67) summarizes this as major wound and/or unconsciousness, while its listed procedure says 'Unconscious with a major wound: go to 191.' The source wording conflicts. Preserve the specific listed procedure as the general rule, and keep chapter-specific authorized HP-zero adaptations separate. Entry-directed insanity text takes precedence; otherwise threshold routing applies.

For a requested skill roll, the player may select a present, awake companion who has the relevant skill. The single-attempt limit applies to the roll overall; switching actors cannot grant another attempt. Each companion needs a separate skill sheet and present/awake/dead state.

Damage assignment order and per-character HP are persistent. Never reduce a companion below zero in combat unless the current source text explicitly allows death. A companion at zero is unconscious and revives if Nadelmann survives the fight. The engine must resolve actual rolls, damage, major wounds, unconsciousness and health.

This is optional. Luck is finite campaign state and must not be spent on any listed excluded roll type. Failed skill checks can use Nadelmann's Luck; companions' separate printed Luck values are not the player Luck pool.

source.text: Getting Started / keywords and repeated play

mechanisms.review: The book explicitly says keywords do not carry over between playthroughs. Keys, missing companions, deaths, temporary incapacity, equipment, weapon counts, supplies and individual HP are state predicates/mutations, not merely prose.

Three independent DEX rolls are requested. Sum STR only for successful actors, then make the specified opposed skill roll against Bernard's 93. Do not expose the conditional results as a free route choice.
The five alternatives are available only after the Survival failure. The river route has a second conditional Luck roll; it must not be simplified into an unconditional choice between 126 and 119.
Record the exact keyword when the instruction is reached. Do not infer it from nearby narrative or make it permanent across attempts.
